trigger emitter
A trigger emitter has the ability to release triggers which in turn are activating triggered ExecutableEntitys. trigger emitter are described by the meta model with provide trigger ports, Trigger in role releasedTrigger, InternalTriggeringPoints and BswInternalTriggeringPoints.

targets.why: Dequeueing triggers released by trigger emitter
Activating triggered ExecutableEntitys from trigger emitter
